#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct FlowEdge {
    int src, dst, cap, rev;
    FlowEdge(int s, int d, int c, int r) : src(s), dst(d), cap(c), rev(r) {}
};

vector<FlowEdge> flowEdges;
vector<vector<int>> adjacency;

int dinicBFS(int source, int sink, vector<int>& level) {
    fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(source);
    level[source] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int idx : adjacency[u]) {
            int v = flowEdges[idx].dst;
            if (flowEdges[idx].cap > 0 && level[v] == -1) {
                level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    return level[sink] != -1;
}

int dinicDFS(int u, int sink, int flow, vector<int>& ptr, vector<int>& level) {
    if (u == sink) return flow;
    for (int& i = ptr[u]; i < adjacency[u].size(); ++i) {
        int e = adjacency[u][i];
        int v = flowEdges[e].dst;
        if (flowEdges[e].cap > 0 && level[v] == level[u] + 1) {
            int pushed = dinicDFS(v, sink, min(flow, flowEdges[e].cap), ptr, level);
            if (pushed > 0) {
                flowEdges[e].cap -= pushed;
                flowEdges[e ^ 1].cap += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
    int total = 0;
    vector<int> level(adjacency.size());
    while (dinicBFS(source, sink, level)) {
        vector<int> ptr(adjacency.size(), 0);
        while (int pushed = dinicDFS(source, sink, INT_MAX, ptr, level)) {
            total += pushed;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

void addFlowEdge(int u, int v, int cap, bool directed = true) {
    flowEdges.emplace_back(u, v, cap, flowEdges.size() + 1);
    adjacency[u].push_back(flowEdges.size() - 1);
    flowEdges.emplace_back(v, u, directed ? 0 : cap, flowEdges.size() - 2);
    adjacency[v].push_back(flowEdges.size() - 1);
}

const int MAX = 11;
int N, T;
char grid[MAX][MAX];
int scientists[MAX][MAX];
int capsules[MAX][MAX];
const int dx[4] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
const int dy[4] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

int timeToInfect[MAX][MAX];

void bfsInfection(int sx, int sy) {
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
            timeToInfect[i][j] = INT_MAX;
    
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    timeToInfect[sx][sy] = 0;
    q.push({sx, sy});
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y] = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
            if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < N && ny < N && timeToInfect[nx][ny] == INT_MAX) {
                timeToInfect[nx][ny] = timeToInfect[x][y] + 1;
                q.push({nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }
}

int encode(int x, int y) { return x * N + y; }

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> N >> T;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            cin >> grid[i][j];
            if (grid[i][j] == 'R') {
                bfsInfection(i, j);
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            cin >> scientists[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            cin >> capsules[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    int src = 2 * N * N;
    int dst = src + 1;
    flowEdges.clear();
    adjacency.assign(2 * N * N + 2, vector<int>());
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'R') {
                addFlowEdge(encode(i, j), encode(i, j) + N * N, scientists[i][j], false);
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'R') {
                addFlowEdge(encode(i, j) + N * N, dst, capsules[i][j], false);
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'R' && timeToInfect[i][j] > T) {
                addFlowEdge(src, encode(i, j), scientists[i][j], false);
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'R') {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k], nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni >= 0 && nj >= 0 && ni < N && nj < N && grid[ni][nj] != 'R') {
                        if (timeToInfect[ni][nj] > timeToInfect[i][j] + 1) {
                            addFlowEdge(encode(i, j), encode(ni, nj), scientists[i][j], false);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << maxFlow(src, dst) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
